== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34691) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Kelly LS MWYHL(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>aa97f766ca9e236c97fbb2f9add36cb48dee941b87ae4bc7f27ca1a994e33634</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
